title: Board: record failed runs and passed reviews, expose comments
body:
## Summary
The board records two new runner events (a run that produced no valid result, and a passed review with the commit SHA it tested), rebuilds them into each ticket, and returns a ticket's comment bodies. This lets the runner count failed runs, resume a Paused ticket to where it was, wait to merge, and check review evidence, all from GitHub state that survives a restart.

## Context
Spec: specs/002-runner.md (Results, After a passing review, Safety and state).

Today `src/board/comments.ts` has event kinds move, claim, release and round, and `boardState` returns `{ round, claim }`. `GitHubBoard` in `src/board/github.ts` builds tickets from that. `BoardAdapter` in `src/board/types.ts` has no way to read comments. `Ticket` is in `src/types.ts`.

Changes:
- `formatRunFailed(reason)` writes `Run failed: <reason>` plus a marker `{ kind: "run-failed", reason }`. `formatPassed(sha)` writes `Review passed on <sha>; waiting to merge.` plus a marker `{ kind: "passed", sha }`. `parseComment` reads both back; a non-string or empty `reason`/`sha` gives `undefined`.
- `boardState` also returns `failedRuns` (run-failed events after the latest move event, 0 if none), `passedSha` (sha of the latest passed event after the latest move event, else absent) and `pausedFrom` (the `from` of the latest move event when its `to` is `Paused` and `from` is not null, else absent).
- `Ticket` gains `failedRuns: number`, `passedSha?: string`, `pausedFrom?: Status`. `get`, `list` and `create` fill them (create: failedRuns 0).
- `BoardAdapter` and `GitHubBoard` gain `recordRunFailed(n, reason)` and `recordPassed(n, sha)` (each posts one comment) and `comments(n): Promise<string[]>` (every comment body, oldest first, across all pages).

## Definition of done
- [ ] `parseComment` reads back what `formatRunFailed` and `formatPassed` write, and returns `undefined` for a passed marker whose sha is empty.
- [ ] `boardState` returns `failedRuns` counted only after the latest move event.
- [ ] `boardState` returns `passedSha` from the latest passed event, and none once a later move event exists.
- [ ] `boardState` returns `pausedFrom` for a ticket whose latest move went to Paused, and none once it has moved on.
- [ ] `GitHubBoard.get` and `list` fill `failedRuns`, `passedSha` and `pausedFrom`; `recordRunFailed` and `recordPassed` each post exactly one comment; `comments(n)` returns every body across `Link` pages, oldest first.
- [ ] The project's existing checks pass: `npm run check` (type check and unit tests).

## Test cases
| # | Type | Steps | Expected result |
|---|------|-------|-----------------|
| 1 | check | `node --input-type=module -e 'const m=await import("./src/board/comments.ts"); console.log(JSON.stringify([m.parseComment(m.formatRunFailed("no block")), m.parseComment(m.formatPassed("abc123")), m.parseComment(m.formatPassed(""))]))'` | Prints `[{"kind":"run-failed","reason":"no block"},{"kind":"passed","sha":"abc123"},null]` |
| 2 | check | `node --input-type=module -e 'const m=await import("./src/board/comments.ts"); console.log(m.boardState([m.formatRunFailed("a"), m.formatMove("QA","QA","x"), m.formatRunFailed("b"), m.formatRunFailed("c")]).failedRuns, m.boardState([]).failedRuns)'` | Prints `2 0` |
| 3 | check | `node --input-type=module -e 'const m=await import("./src/board/comments.ts"); console.log(m.boardState([m.formatPassed("abc")]).passedSha, m.boardState([m.formatPassed("abc"), m.formatMove("QA","Done","merged")]).passedSha)'` | Prints `abc undefined` |
| 4 | check | `node --input-type=module -e 'const m=await import("./src/board/comments.ts"); console.log(m.boardState([m.formatMove("QA","Paused","limit")]).pausedFrom, m.boardState([m.formatMove("QA","Paused","limit"), m.formatMove("Paused","QA","resumed")]).pausedFrom)'` | Prints `QA undefined` |
| 5 | check | Run `node --test test/github-board.test.ts`, the new case: issue #5 labelled `status: qa` with comments [run-failed, run-failed, passed `abc`] on two `Link` pages | The test asserts `get(5)` gives `failedRuns` 2 and `passedSha` `"abc"`, and `comments(5)` gives the 3 bodies in that order; it passes |
| 6 | check | Same file, the new case: `recordRunFailed(5, "crash")` then `recordPassed(5, "abc")` against the fake fetch | The test asserts exactly two POSTs to `/repos/acme/widgets/issues/5/comments`, whose bodies parse back to run-failed `crash` and passed `abc`; it passes |
| 7 | check | Run `npm run check` | Type check exits 0 and every test passes |

## Dependencies
- none

## Files likely touched
- src/board/comments.ts
- src/board/github.ts
- src/board/types.ts
- src/types.ts
- test/comments.test.ts
- test/github-board.test.ts

## Out of scope
No change to status or claim labels, to the existing move, claim, release and round comment formats, or to how round and claim are rebuilt. No pull request or CI calls. No runner logic. No network calls in tests.

title: GitHub pull request client
body:
## Summary
Add a small REST client for the pull request operations the runner needs: find a ticket's pull request, list its files and diff size, read CI status for a commit, and squash-merge at a given SHA.

## Context
Spec: specs/002-runner.md (Constraints, After a build, After a passing review).

Nothing in the repo talks to pull requests today. `src/board/github.ts` shows the request pattern to follow: same headers as `src/scripts/create-tickets.ts`, an injectable `fetch`, `Link: rel="next"` pagination, and errors that carry the HTTP status and never the token.

New `src/github/pulls.ts` exporting a `Pulls` interface and `new GitHubPulls({ repo, token, fetch? })`:
- `forTicket(n)`: `GET /repos/{repo}/pulls?head={owner}:foreman/ticket-{n}&state=all&per_page=100`. Returns the highest-numbered open one, else the highest-numbered merged one, else `undefined` (closed unmerged ones are ignored), as `{ number, url, headRef, headSha, state }` with `state` one of `open`, `merged`, `closed` (`merged` when `merged_at` is set).
- `files(pr)`: `GET /pulls/{pr}/files` across pages; returns `{ paths, changedLines }` where `changedLines` is the sum of additions and deletions.
- `ciStatus(sha)`: `GET /commits/{sha}/check-runs?per_page=100`. No check runs: `pending`. Any completed run with conclusion failure, cancelled, timed_out, action_required or startup_failure: `red`. Otherwise any run not completed: `pending`. Otherwise `green`.
- `squashMerge(pr, sha)`: `PUT /pulls/{pr}/merge` with `{ merge_method: "squash", sha }`.
The runner names every ticket branch `foreman/ticket-<n>` (the branch name already used for spec 001's tickets).

## Definition of done
- [ ] `forTicket` prefers an open pull request over a merged one, ignores closed unmerged ones, and returns `undefined` when none match.
- [ ] `files` follows pagination and sums additions and deletions into `changedLines`.
- [ ] `ciStatus` returns `green`, `red` or `pending` by the rules in Context.
- [ ] `squashMerge` sends `PUT .../pulls/<pr>/merge` with `merge_method` `squash` and the given `sha`.
- [ ] A non-2xx response rejects with an error that contains the status code and not the token.
- [ ] The project's existing checks pass: `npm run check` (type check and unit tests).

## Test cases
| # | Type | Steps | Expected result |
|---|------|-------|-----------------|
| 1 | check | With `FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN` set, run `node --input-type=module -e 'const {GitHubPulls}=await import("./src/github/pulls.ts"); const p=new GitHubPulls({repo:"ahmadtharik/foreman",token:process.env.FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN}); const pr=await p.forTicket(6); console.log(pr.number, pr.state, pr.headRef, await p.forTicket(999999))'` | Prints `13 merged foreman/ticket-6 undefined` |
| 2 | check | Same setup, run `node --input-type=module -e 'const {GitHubPulls}=await import("./src/github/pulls.ts"); const p=new GitHubPulls({repo:"ahmadtharik/foreman",token:process.env.FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN}); console.log(await p.ciStatus("49c778328ed7a4ac39de0eb14cc243f256ed33c3"))'` | Prints `green` (that commit has one check run, `check`, completed with success) |
| 3 | check | Run `node --test test/pulls.test.ts`, the case: fake pulls list holds #4 closed unmerged, #5 merged, #7 open; then a list holding only #4 | The test asserts `forTicket` returns #7 with state `open`, then `undefined`; it passes |
| 4 | check | Same file, the case: files page 1 (with a `Link` next header) has a file with 10 additions and 2 deletions, page 2 has one with 0 and 5 | The test asserts `paths` has both names and `changedLines` is 17; it passes |
| 5 | check | Same file, the cases for `ciStatus`: zero runs; one success plus one in_progress; one success plus one completed failure; success plus skipped | The test asserts `pending`, `pending`, `red`, `green` in that order; it passes |
| 6 | check | Same file, the case: `squashMerge(7, "abc")` | The test asserts one request, method PUT, url ending `/pulls/7/merge`, body `{"merge_method":"squash","sha":"abc"}`; it passes |
| 7 | check | Same file, the case: fake fetch answers 409, token `secret-token-123`, call `squashMerge(7, "abc")` | The test asserts the rejection message contains `409` and does not contain `secret-token-123`; it passes |
| 8 | check | Run `npm run check` | Type check exits 0 and every test passes |

## Dependencies
- none

## Files likely touched
- src/github/pulls.ts
- test/pulls.test.ts

## Out of scope
No change to `src/board/`. No issue or label operations. No creating, editing or closing pull requests. No `gh` CLI, no new runtime dependencies, no network calls in tests.

title: Git worktree per ticket run
body:
## Summary
Add a module that gives each agent run its own git worktree of the target repo: a build starts from the latest `origin/main` or continues the ticket's existing branch, a review checks out the ticket's branch and reports the commit SHA it is testing.

## Context
Spec: specs/002-runner.md (Running an agent).

Nothing creates worktrees today; for spec 001 a human did it by hand. `exec` in `src/agent/claude-code.ts` shows how the repo spawns processes. `runs/` is already in `.gitignore`.

New `src/runner/worktree.ts` exporting a `Worktrees` interface and `new GitWorktrees({ repoPath, root, git? })`. `git(args, cwd)` resolves `{ code, stdout, stderr }` and defaults to spawning `git`.
- `prepare(ticket, stage)` runs `git fetch origin` and `git worktree prune` in `repoPath`. Branch is `foreman/ticket-<n>`; path is `<root>/ticket-<n>-<stage>-<Date.now()>`.
  - build: if `refs/remotes/origin/<branch>` exists (`git rev-parse --verify --quiet`), `git worktree add -B <branch> <path> origin/<branch>`; else the same from `origin/main`.
  - review: `git worktree add --detach <path> origin/<branch>`; if the remote branch does not exist, reject with `no branch origin/foreman/ticket-<n> to review`.
  - Resolves `{ path, branch, headSha }`, `headSha` from `git rev-parse HEAD` in the new worktree.
- `remove(path)` runs `git worktree remove --force <path>`.
- Any git command that exits non-zero rejects with an error naming the command and its stderr.

## Definition of done
- [ ] A build for a ticket with no remote branch gets a worktree on new branch `foreman/ticket-<n>` at `origin/main`.
- [ ] A build for a ticket whose branch exists on origin gets a worktree on that branch at its remote tip.
- [ ] A review gets a detached worktree at `origin/foreman/ticket-<n>` and its `headSha`; with no remote branch it rejects with the message in Context.
- [ ] `remove` deletes the worktree; a failing git command rejects with the command and stderr in the message.
- [ ] The project's existing checks pass: `npm run check` (type check and unit tests).

## Test cases
| # | Type | Steps | Expected result |
|---|------|-------|-----------------|
| 1 | check | In Git Bash from the repo root: `F=$PWD; T=$(mktemp -d); git init -q --bare $T/o.git && git clone -q $T/o.git $T/c && cd $T/c && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -q --allow-empty -m init && git push -q origin HEAD:main && cd $F && node --input-type=module -e 'const {GitWorktrees}=await import("./src/runner/worktree.ts"); const w=new GitWorktrees({repoPath:process.argv[1],root:process.argv[1]+"/../wt"}); const r=await w.prepare(1,"build"); console.log(r.branch, r.headSha)' $T/c; git -C $T/c rev-parse origin/main` | First line is `foreman/ticket-1 <sha>`, and `<sha>` equals the sha printed on the last line |
| 2 | check | Continue in the same shell: in the worktree from case 1, commit an empty commit and `git push -q origin foreman/ticket-1`, remove the worktree with `w.remove`, then call `prepare(1, "build")` again and `prepare(1, "review")` | Both print `headSha` equal to `git -C $T/c rev-parse origin/foreman/ticket-1`, which differs from `origin/main`; the review worktree's `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` prints `HEAD` |
| 3 | check | Same shell, call `prepare(2, "review")` | Rejects with a message containing `no branch origin/foreman/ticket-2 to review` |
| 4 | check | Same shell, call `remove(<path from case 1>)` then `git -C $T/c worktree list`; then call `remove("$T/nope")` | The removed path is no longer listed; the second call rejects with a message containing `worktree remove` and git's stderr |
| 5 | check | Run `node --test test/worktree.test.ts`, the case: fake git where `rev-parse --verify` exits 1 | The test asserts the git argument lists in order: `fetch origin`, `worktree prune`, `rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/remotes/origin/foreman/ticket-3`, `worktree add -B foreman/ticket-3 <path> origin/main`, `rev-parse HEAD`; it passes |
| 6 | check | Run `npm run check` | Type check exits 0 and every test passes |

## Dependencies
- none

## Files likely touched
- src/runner/worktree.ts
- test/worktree.test.ts

## Out of scope
No agent runs, no board calls, no pull request calls. No pushing, committing or deleting branches. Unit tests fake git and never spawn it. No new runtime dependencies.

title: Runner cycle: promote, release, pick, run, apply results
body:
## Summary
Add `runCycle`, one pass of the runner: resume Paused tickets, promote Backlog tickets whose dependencies are Done, release stale claims, pick at most one eligible ticket per stage, run its agent in a fresh worktree, and apply the stage table plus the round cap, usage-limit and failed-run rules. A dry-run mode logs what it would do and changes nothing.

## Context
Spec: specs/002-runner.md (Cycle, Running an agent, Results, Safety and state).

Uses `BoardAdapter` with `failedRuns`, `pausedFrom`, `passedSha` and `recordRunFailed` from #T1; `Worktrees` from #T3; `AgentAdapter` and `AgentRunOutcome` from `src/agent/types.ts`; `Settings` and the stage table from `src/config.ts`.

New `src/runner/cycle.ts` exporting `runCycle(deps)`, with `deps = { board, agents: Record<StageName, AgentAdapter>, worktrees, settings, runnerId, now, log, dryRun?, secrets? }`. `log(ticket | null, action, reason)` is one line per action. Every text written to the board or the log has each string in `secrets` replaced by `***`.

Order within one cycle:
1. Each Paused ticket moves to its `pausedFrom` (Ready if unknown), reason `resumed after usage limit`.
2. Each Backlog ticket whose dependencies are all Done moves to Ready. A dependency not in the open list is read with `board.get`; a failed read counts as not Done.
3. Each claim older than `claimTimeoutMin` is released, reason `stale claim by <by> for <stage> since <iso>, older than <N> min`.
4. For each stage in the table, the lowest-numbered eligible ticket: status in the stage's triggers, no claim younger than `claimTimeoutMin`, body parsed, dependencies Done, and no `passedSha`. Stages run at the same time; one ticket per stage.
5. For a pick: claim; a Ready ticket moves to In progress (`build started`); prepare the worktree; run the agent with the stage's skill and `round: ticket.round`; remove the worktree; apply the outcome; release the claim in all cases.
   - result: the stage table. A `move` posts reason `<result>: <reason>`. A `fail` (countRound) in round `maxRounds` or later moves to Needs human with `round cap <maxRounds> reached`; otherwise `setRound(round + 1)` then the move. `retry` (environment) only logs.
   - usage-limit: move to Paused, no round.
   - no-result, crashed, a thrown error, or a result whose stage or ticket number does not match the run: `recordRunFailed`; when that makes 3 since the last move, move to Needs human with `3 runs in a row without a valid result`.
With `dryRun`, steps 1 to 4 log `would ...` lines and call no board write, no worktree and no agent.

## Definition of done
- [ ] A Backlog ticket whose dependencies are all Done moves to Ready; one with a dependency not Done stays in Backlog.
- [ ] A claim older than `claimTimeoutMin` is released with the logged reason; a younger one is not, and its ticket is not picked.
- [ ] Only eligible tickets are picked, at most one per stage, lowest number first.
- [ ] Each stage-table result applies its move; `fail` adds a round; `fail` in round `maxRounds` goes to Needs human; `environment` changes nothing and adds no round.
- [ ] A usage limit moves the ticket to Paused with no round, and the next cycle moves it back to the status it came from.
- [ ] A no-result or crash records a failed run and leaves the status; the third in a row moves the ticket to Needs human.
- [ ] Restarting mid-ticket: a ticket left claimed by a killed runner is released once stale and picked again by the same cycle.
- [ ] Dry run makes no board write, worktree or agent call, and logs one `would` line per action.
- [ ] No secret string appears in any board text or log line.
- [ ] The project's existing checks pass: `npm run check` (type check and unit tests).

## Test cases
| # | Type | Steps | Expected result |
|---|------|-------|-----------------|
| 1 | check | Run `node --test test/cycle.test.ts`, the case: Backlog #2 depends on #1 (Done), Backlog #3 depends on #1 and #2 | The test asserts after one cycle #2 is Ready and #3 is Backlog; it passes |
| 2 | check | Same file, the case: QA #4 claimed 61 min ago, QA #5 claimed 10 min ago, `claimTimeoutMin` 60 | The test asserts #4 gets a release whose reason starts `stale claim by`, #4 is the reviewed ticket, and #5 has no release and no agent run; it passes |
| 3 | check | Same file, the case: Ready #9, Ready #7, Ready #6 with a dependency In progress, Ready #8 with an unparseable body, QA #10 with `passedSha` set, QA #11 | The test asserts the build agent ran once for #7 and the review agent once for #11, and nothing ran for #6, #8, #9, #10; it passes |
| 4 | check | Same file, the cases: build `built`, build `blocked`, review `pass`, review `test-case-wrong`, review `environment`, each on a ticket in round 1 | The test asserts final statuses QA, Needs human, Done, Needs human, QA, with no `setRound` call in any of them; it passes |
| 5 | check | Same file, the cases: review `fail` in round 1 and in round 3, `maxRounds` 3 | The test asserts round 1: `setRound(n, 2)` and status In progress; round 3: no `setRound` and status Needs human with reason `round cap 3 reached`; it passes |
| 6 | check | Same file, the case: QA #12 review returns usage-limit, then a second cycle with no agent result | The test asserts after cycle 1 #12 is Paused with no `setRound`; after cycle 2 it is QA with reason `resumed after usage limit`; it passes |
| 7 | check | Same file, the case: Ready #13 build crashes three cycles running, then a result with the wrong ticket number on another ticket | The test asserts #13 is In progress after cycles 1 and 2 with `failedRuns` 1 then 2, and Needs human after cycle 3 with reason `3 runs in a row without a valid result`; the wrong-number result records a failed run and moves nothing; it passes |
| 8 | check | Same file, the case: QA #14 claimed 61 min ago by `old-runner` (simulating a killed runner), a fresh cycle with runner id `new-runner` | The test asserts #14 is released, then claimed by `new-runner`, and reviewed in that cycle; it passes |
| 9 | check | Same file, the case: `dryRun` true with one Paused, one promotable Backlog, one stale claim and one Ready ticket | The test asserts zero board write calls, zero worktree calls, zero agent calls, and log lines containing `would resume`, `would promote`, `would release` and `would start build`; it passes |
| 10 | check | Same file, the case: `secrets: ["tok-123"]`, a build returns `blocked` with reason `saw tok-123` | The test asserts no board text and no log line contains `tok-123`, and the move reason contains `***`; it passes |
| 11 | check | Run `npm run check` | Type check exits 0 and every test passes |

## Dependencies
- #T1
- #T3

## Files likely touched
- src/runner/cycle.ts
- test/cycle.test.ts
- test/fakes.ts

## Out of scope
No pull request, diff or CI checks after a build, no evidence check and no merge after a review (the next ticket). No entry script, lock file or log file. No change to the stage table, `src/result.ts`, `src/agent/` or the skills. No network, git or Claude Code in tests.

title: Runner cycle: check the build's diff, check review evidence, merge on green CI
body:
## Summary
Extend `runCycle` so that after a build it checks the pull request's files and size before QA, after a review it accepts `pass` only with evidence for every test case, and a passed ticket is squash-merged at the reviewed commit once CI is green (or moved to Done after a human merges, in supervised mode).

## Context
Spec: specs/002-runner.md (Results, After a build, After a passing review).

Uses `runCycle` from #T4, `Pulls` from #T2, and `comments`, `recordPassed`, `passedSha` from #T1. The report format the reviewer writes is in `.claude/skills/foreman-review/SKILL.md` (`Result: PASS`, then a table of `#`, `Result`, `Evidence`). `settings.autonomy` and `settings.maxDiffLines` are in `src/config.ts`.

Changes:
- `deps` gains `pulls`.
- New `src/runner/evidence.ts` exporting `checkEvidence(testCases, comments): string[]` (problems; empty means OK). It reads the latest comment containing a line `Result: PASS`; each ticket test case id must have a row whose result is `pass` and whose evidence is not empty, `-`, `none` or `n/a`. No such comment gives the problem `no PASS report`; otherwise one problem per missing case, `no evidence for test case <id>`.
- After `built`: `pulls.forTicket(n)` must return an open pull request, else it is a failed run (`built but no open pull request on foreman/ticket-<n>`). Paths from `pulls.files` not listed in "Files likely touched" go in one ticket comment starting `Files outside "Files likely touched":`. If `changedLines` exceeds `maxDiffLines`, move to Needs human with `diff of <x> lines exceeds maxDiffLines <y>`; else move to QA.
- After `pass`: run `checkEvidence` over the comments after this run's claim comment. Problems: a failed run with reason `pass rejected: <problems>`, status stays QA. None: `recordPassed(n, headSha)` with the worktree's `headSha`, status stays QA.
- New step after releasing stale claims, for each QA ticket with `passedSha`: if its pull request is already merged, move to Done (`pull request #<pr> merged`). In `supervised` mode, otherwise only log `waiting for a human to merge`. Otherwise read `ciStatus(passedSha)`: `green` squash-merges with that sha and moves to Done (`merged #<pr> at <sha>`); `red` or `pending` logs `waiting: CI <status> on <sha>`; a merge that rejects is logged and the ticket stays in QA. In dry run this step logs `would merge` or the waiting line and writes nothing.

## Definition of done
- [ ] `checkEvidence` returns no problems for a report with an evidenced pass row per test case, and names each case that lacks one.
- [ ] A `pass` without full evidence leaves the ticket in QA, records a failed run with the reason, and the ticket is reviewed again next cycle.
- [ ] A `pass` with full evidence records the reviewed SHA and does not merge in the same step.
- [ ] A passed ticket is squash-merged with the recorded SHA and moved to Done only when CI is green; red or pending leaves it in QA and merges nothing.
- [ ] In supervised mode the runner never merges, and moves the ticket to Done once the pull request is merged.
- [ ] After a build, files outside "Files likely touched" are named in one ticket comment, and a diff over `maxDiffLines` moves the ticket to Needs human instead of QA.
- [ ] A restart after a recorded pass carries on to the merge from the board alone.
- [ ] The project's existing checks pass: `npm run check` (type check and unit tests).

## Test cases
| # | Type | Steps | Expected result |
|---|------|-------|-----------------|
| 1 | check | Run `node --test test/evidence.test.ts`, the case: test cases 1, 2, 3; one comment `Result: PASS` with rows for 1 (`pass`, `exit 0`), 2 (`pass`, empty evidence), and no row for 3 | The test asserts the problems are exactly `no evidence for test case 2` and `no evidence for test case 3`; it passes |
| 2 | check | Same file, the cases: no comment contains `Result: PASS`; and a full report with every row `pass` with evidence | The test asserts `["no PASS report"]`, then `[]`; it passes |
| 3 | check | Run `node --test test/cycle.test.ts`, the case: QA #20 review returns `pass`, no report comment after the claim; then a second cycle | The test asserts #20 stays QA, one failed run whose reason starts `pass rejected:`, no `recordPassed`, and the review agent runs again in cycle 2; it passes |
| 4 | check | Same file, the case: QA #21 review returns `pass` with a full report, worktree `headSha` `abc` | The test asserts `recordPassed(21, "abc")`, status QA, and no `squashMerge` call in that cycle; it passes |
| 5 | check | Same file, the cases: QA #22 with `passedSha` `abc`, open PR #30, `ciStatus` `pending`, then `red`, then `green` | The test asserts no `squashMerge` and status QA for pending and red; for green `squashMerge(30, "abc")` and status Done with reason `merged #30 at abc`; it passes |
| 6 | check | Same file, the case: autonomy `supervised`, QA #23 with `passedSha`, CI green, PR open; then the PR reported merged | The test asserts no `squashMerge` in either cycle, status QA after the first, Done after the second; it passes |
| 7 | check | Same file, the case: build `built` on #24, PR files `src/a.ts`, `src/b.ts`, Files likely touched `src/a.ts`, `changedLines` 120, `maxDiffLines` 600; and the same with `changedLines` 601 | The test asserts first: one comment containing `src/b.ts` and not `src/a.ts`, status QA; second: status Needs human with reason `diff of 601 lines exceeds maxDiffLines 600`; it passes |
| 8 | check | Same file, the case: build `built` on #25 and `forTicket` returns undefined | The test asserts a failed run with reason `built but no open pull request on foreman/ticket-25` and status In progress; it passes |
| 9 | check | Same file, the case: a new runner starts with QA #26 already carrying `passedSha` `def` and CI green | The test asserts the first cycle calls `squashMerge(<pr>, "def")`, moves #26 to Done, and runs no agent on #26; it passes |
| 10 | check | Run `npm run check` | Type check exits 0 and every test passes |

## Dependencies
- #T2
- #T4

## Files likely touched
- src/runner/cycle.ts
- src/runner/evidence.ts
- test/cycle.test.ts
- test/evidence.test.ts
- test/fakes.ts

## Out of scope
No change to the reviewer's report format, the skills or the stage table. No pull request creation or editing, no closing issues. No entry script, lock or log file. No network, git or Claude Code in tests.

title: `npm run runner`: entry script, lock file, log file, dry run
body:
## Summary Add `npm run runner`, which loads settings, takes a lock so only one runner runs, wires the real board, pull request client, worktrees and Claude Code agents into `runCycle`, and repeats every `pollIntervalSec`, logging each action to the console and a file under `logs/`. `--dry-run` prints one cycle of what it would do and exits. ## Context Spec: specs/002-runner.md (the command, Safety and state, How we will know it works). Uses `runCycle` from #T5, `GitHubPulls` from #T2, `GitWorktrees` from #T3, `GitHubBoard` (`src/board/github.ts`), `ClaudeCodeAgent` (`src/agent/claude-code.ts`, with `keepEnv`), `loadSettings` (`src/config.ts`). `*.lock`, `logs/` and `runs/` are already in `.gitignore`. Changes: - New `src/runner/lock.ts`: `acquireLock(path)` creates the file exclusively and writes the pid. If the file exists and that pid is alive, it throws `Another runner is already running (pid ). Lock file: `. If that pid is not alive, it takes the lock over and says so. The returned `release()` deletes the file. - New `src/runner/log.ts`: `createLog({ dir, secrets, now? })` returns `log(ticket, action, reason)` that writes ` # : ` (`-` for no ticket) to stdout and appends it to `/runner-.log`, with each secret replaced by `***`. - New `src/scripts/runner.ts` and `"runner": "node src/scripts/runner.ts"` in `package.json`. It exits 1 with `FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN is not set` if it is missing. Lock file `foreman.lock` in the working directory; released on exit, SIGINT and SIGTERM. Runner id `-`. Worktrees under `runs/worktrees` in the working directory, repo at `targetPath`. One `ClaudeCodeAgent` per stage with `allowedTools[stage]`, `keepEnv: ["FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN"]` and `agentTimeoutMin`. The token is passed as a secret to the log and the cycle. A cycle that throws is logged and the loop goes on. - `--dry-run`: one cycle with `dryRun: true`, no lock, then exit 0. - `DEFAULTS.allowedTools` in `src/config.ts` gains `Bash(curl *)` at the end of both the build and the review list, so the builder can open its pull request and the reviewer can post its report through the GitHub REST API under `claude -p` (where tools not listed are refused). - README: a short "Runner" section with both commands. ## Definition of done - [ ] `npm run runner -- --dry-run` on the real repo prints one line per intended action, changes no label or comment, and exits 0. - [ ] A second runner is refused by the lock with the message in Context and exit code 1; a lock left by a dead pid is taken over. - [ ] Each log line goes to the console and to `logs/runner-.log`, and never contains the token. - [ ] Without `FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN` the runner exits 1 with `FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN is not set`. - [ ] Agents receive `FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN` and no API key. - [ ] The default allowed tools of both stages end with `Bash(curl *)`. - [ ] The project's existing checks pass: `npm run check` (type check and unit tests). ## Test cases | # | Type | Steps | Expected result | |---|------|-------|-----------------| | 1 | check | With `foreman.config.json` targeting `ahmadtharik/foreman` and `FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN` set: note the comment count of every open issue labelled `status: *` (REST `GET /repos/ahmadtharik/foreman/issues/` field `comments`), run `npm run runner -- --dry-run`, note the counts again | Exit code 0; each printed action line contains `would` (or the output says there is nothing to do); every count and every status label is unchanged | | 2 | check | Run `node -e "setTimeout(()=>{},60000)" & P=$!; echo $P > foreman.lock; FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN=bogus npm run runner; echo exit $?; kill $P` | Prints `Another runner is already running (pid

). Lock file: foreman.lock` and `exit 1` | | 3 | check | Run `node --input-type=module -e 'const {acquireLock}=await import("./src/runner/lock.ts"); const fs=await import("node:fs"); fs.writeFileSync("t.lock","999999"); const l=acquireLock("t.lock"); console.log(fs.readFileSync("t.lock","utf8")==String(process.pid)); l.release(); console.log(fs.existsSync("t.lock"))'` | Prints `true` then `false` | | 4 | check | Run `node --input-type=module -e 'const {createLog}=await import("./src/runner/log.ts"); const log=createLog({dir:"logs-test",secrets:["tok-123"],now:()=>new Date("2026-11-22T10:00:00Z")}); log(7,"move","saw tok-123"); log(null,"cycle","done")'` then `cat logs-test/runner-2026-11-22.log` | Console and file both show `2026-11-22T10:00:00.000Z #7 move: saw ***` and `2026-11-22T10:00:00.000Z - cycle: done` | | 5 | check | Run `env -u FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN npm run runner -- --dry-run; echo exit $?` | Prints `FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN is not set` and `exit 1` | | 6 | check | `node --input-type=module -e 'const {agentEnv}=await import("./src/agent/env.ts"); console.log(JSON.stringify(agentEnv({FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN:"t",ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:"k",PATH:"/bin"},["FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN"])))'`, and read `src/scripts/runner.ts` for the `keepEnv` passed to each `ClaudeCodeAgent` | Prints `{"FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN":"t","PATH":"/bin"}`; every `ClaudeCodeAgent` is constructed with `keepEnv: ["FOREMAN_GITHUB_TOKEN"]` and nothing sets an API key | | 7 | check | `node --input-type=module -e 'const {DEFAULTS}=await import("./src/config.ts"); console.log(DEFAULTS.allowedTools.build.at(-1), DEFAULTS.allowedTools.review.at(-1))'` | Prints `Bash(curl *) Bash(curl *)` | | 8 | check | Run `npm run check` | Type check exits 0 and every test passes | ## Dependencies - #T5 ## Files likely touched - src/scripts/runner.ts - src/runner/lock.ts - src/runner/log.ts - package.json - README.md - src/config.ts - test/lock.test.ts - test/log.test.ts ## Out of scope No change to cycle rules, the stage table, the skills, or any allowed tool other than adding `Bash(curl *)`. No more than one builder and one reviewer at a time. No run report page, webhooks, UI or Projects board. No planner stage. No new runtime dependencies, no `gh` CLI, no API key.
